'''Mustafarian Soldiers''',<ref name="Mustafarian Soldier">{{SWMiniCite|set=Bounty Hunters|pack=Mustafarian Soldier}}</ref> also known as '''Mustafar Sentries''', were [[Mustafarian/Legends|nothern Mustafarians]] enlisted by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Mustafar Sentry" /> to guard their smelting facilities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="Mustafarian Soldier" />

When [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] came to [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|eliminate]] the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] in its [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|secret bunker]], two Mustafarian sentries let him pass and were spared from his wrath.<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>
